property_summary: For all inputs, in the reference C calling SetLogFile(...) before Initialized() returns successfully and sets LogFile; the mutant inverts the guard so SetLogFile(...) reverts before Initialized() and only succeeds after Initialized(), violating that universal property.
change_summary: Replace the guard that reverts when intitalized is true with a guard that reverts when intitalized is false, causing SetLogFile to only work after Initialized() has been called.
